findings.title: Bound background-agent stop requests
findings.description: After the idle timeout, agents are stopped sequentially with unbounded `await self.client.stop_task(task_id)` calls. The exception handler only logs after a call returns or raises; it cannot prevent a stalled stop request from delaying dispatch completion. With multiple agents, the delay can accumulate. Bound each stop request or otherwise ensure cleanup cannot indefinitely hold the dispatch.

findings.title: Reject invalid background idle-timeout values
findings.description: The new timeout setting accepts any integer, including negatives, and `get_typed_config(..., int)` also accepts TOML booleans because `bool` is a subclass of `int`. These values reach `asyncio.timeout` directly and can make a dispatch stop tracked agents immediately instead of waiting for a valid silence interval. Validate that the setting is a non-boolean, non-negative timeout (or explicitly document and handle any special values).

findings.title: Add a load test for background dispatch waiting
findings.description: This change adds asynchronous stream handling, background-task waiting, idle timeouts, and stop requests, but the added session tests use scripted clients and short unit-test timeouts. The project’s testing rules require a realistic load test for network/concurrency paths that asserts latency, throughput, or resource bounds; there is no corresponding SDK-session test under `tests/load/`.

structured_findings.summary: Add a load test for background dispatch waiting
